verse.name: b1a
verse.lines:
We lift our holy hands up
We want to touch You
We lift our voices higher
Higher, higher to You

verse.name: c1
verse.lines:
We are hungry, we are hungry
We are hungry for more of You
We are thirsty, oh Jesus
We are thirsty for more of You

verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
We lift You high, we lift You high
Be glorified, we lift You high
Oh, we lift You high

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
Lord I want more of You
Living water rain down on me
Lord I need more of You
Living breath of life come fill me

verse.name: v1c
verse.lines:
Lord I want more of You
Holy Spirit rain down on me
Lord I need more of You
Living breath of life come fill me up

verse.name: b1b
verse.lines:
We lift You high, we lift You high
We lift You high, higher
We lift You high, we lift You high
Be glorified, be glorified
We lift You high, we lift You high
We lift You high, we lift You high
We lift You high, we lift You high
We lift You high, be glorified

verse.name: v1d
verse.lines:
I will raise my voice
I will raise my voice, I will raise my voice
To You, to You
I will lift my hands
I will lift my life
To give You glory
